visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman wearing a pink crop top and denim shorts walks towards a man who is seated on a white couch in a living room. The man is dressed in a black sweatshirt and black pants, looking down at a smartphone in his hands. The background is composed of beige horizontal blinds and a red decorative frame. (2) The woman sits next to the man on the couch, leaning close and touching his arm with her hand. She smiles at him while speaking, showing a playful facial expression. The man looks up at her with a neutral, slightly skeptical gaze before looking back at his phone screen. (3) The man reaches into his pocket and pulls out a stack of blue banknotes, handing them to the woman. She accepts the money with a joyful smile, holding it in her hands. The room is brightly lit with even, indoor lighting that illuminates the characters clearly. (4) In a sudden movement, the man reaches back and snatches the banknotes out of the woman's hand. He immediately stands up and begins to walk out of the frame toward the right. The woman remains on the couch, her eyes wide and her mouth open in a shocked expression. (5) The video transitions to a black and white comic-style illustration. The first frame shows the woman's surprised face as the man's arm exits the shot. The second frame is a close-up of her face with an exaggeratedly shocked and angry expression, featuring large eyes and a gaping mouth.
